safeToShare.description: False only when the hold expired and was purged and was not re-booked. True for a live reservation, a re-booked one, an already-shared booking, and an unreachable courtscheduler.

status.description: REBOOKED means the hold had expired and, because the request set reserveIfExpired and the session still had room, courtscheduler took it again under the same booking id. UNKNOWN means courtscheduler could not be reached and the check failed open; courtscheduler itself never emits it.
